description: Canadian Vickers-built Canso/OA-10A c/n CV-332 (ex-French Navy 32), the Parragué family's second Catalina, kept at Arturo Merino Benítez airport since 2006 in ground-running condition and repainted as FACh 405 Manutara; offered for sale on Trade-A-Plane in March 2019 (modocharlie.com). Whether it is still at the airport needs confirmation.
